I read the actual current diffs, PR metadata/discussions, and associated PR-head offline CI for all SIX OPEN Castle PRs. This is a recommendation to Mark, NOT authorization for a merge or close. Owner previously said hold Castle this round, and the hold remains until new owner word.

Castle:
- #28 MERGE candidate — archive/talk docs only, 4 new Markdown files, 536 additions, mergeable, offline verification SUCCESS.
- #29 MERGE candidate — 80-line historical archival document, draft, mergeable, offline verification SUCCESS; mark ready only with new owner go.
- #30 MERGE candidate — new scripted Peanut Gallery JSON + rooms.csv row + SPEC ONLY for later local-checkpoint bridge, mergeable, offline verification SUCCESS. All three guest bot IDs exist; browser theater.js does NOT include this room until separate, Mark-gated code change. No live models deployed.
- #3 CLOSE-BRANCH-KEPT candidate — old OpenRouter review handoff, superseded by already merged read_room implementation; current PR is conflicting.
- #5 HOLD — local Sensor Trio is real distinct optional implementation, not automatically superseded by EKO. Existing Meraki review documents silent tokenizer truncation/whole-text measurement-integrity flaw; no merge without fail-closed or explicit truncation disclosure and negative tests. If owner wants full cleanup instead, closing with branch kept preserves it.
- #6 CLOSE-BRANCH-KEPT candidate — October team-bus/MCP design superseded operationally by ALLur/EKO; preserve unimplemented nonce-bound ACK and validated digest-ID/hash contract ideas as historical reference. Existing PR review cites duplicate-ID and hash-preimage limitations.

On the OTHER two conflict-blocked archive PRs: talks-main #5 and art-talk #4 both belong to PRIVATE repos; they carry substantial sensitive/internal source intake, not easy one-line fixes (3971 and 4662 additions). Recommendation: HOLD FOR TARGETED CONFLICT RESOLUTION AND CONTENT/PRIVACY REVIEW, not automatic force-merge or unreviewed public export. Z needn't execute these during Castle review.

Still open: /circle-react two handler prefixes on issue #16. Z has accepted the selection of new owner-gated circle-react.yml but has not yet renamed/disabled legacy handler. Remain NO PAID /circle-react until that change and zero-spend single-handler verification. Owner word required.

No PR merged/closed, no code changed, no workflows fired or spending from this advisory. — Sol

text:
Mark's latest direction: "Keep talk separate art gets its own repo, eventually. And let's inspect 30 if we can do some getting on that today to get it to the next step."

I interpret that as keeping Castle's interactive rooms/characters distinct from talk/art archive material. Therefore HOLD lightbringers-castle #28 (which would place docs/talks in Castle) pending its routing into the appropriate talks or future art repository. Do not silently merge #28 as part of the Castle content batch. The owner's future art-repo decision is distinct and no new repository has been created. #29 stays a Castle-only historical archive candidate pending owner merge decision.

I inspected Castle #30 (Peanut Gallery). It contains exactly room JSON + registry row + proposed offline historical checkpoint bridge spec. Found one semantic concern: scripted jokes initially claimed every line already had checkpoint tickets/receipts, though actual historical-model import is not implemented. Made a small separate owner-review **draft** #31 based on #30 branch, not main:
https://github.com/MarkDude-design/lightbringers-castle/pull/31

#31 wires the room as the 11th door in scripted browser theater, updates the theater docs, clearly labels the stage ledger and the BERT/GPT-2/DialoGPT lines as scripted (real receipts only future), syncs registry description, adds offline tests. The parent #30 is NOT merged; this stacked child is NOT merged. No live model inference, keys, spending, web deployment or public talk/art routing. CI currently running for #31; results will be checked.

Do not merge #30/#31 without fresh owner review; parent-before-child order if accepted. Z needn't take any action now. — Sol
